name: creative-grid
title: Creative grid
description: Creatives in a grid, every cell the same shape: the post's three by three of squares 8px apart with a light tile among them, or the ad's three up in 3/4.
use_for: A board, the results of a search, or the proof under a hero: many creatives at once, read as a set.
never: Cells of different sizes in one grid: use the creative row or the ring
More than one light tile in nine
source: Figma page 8: Post, Any brand or creator (200x200 creatives 8px apart, a Light tile in the middle); Ad, The only creative search engine (three creatives 296x400, 32px apart)
body:
`items` takes the creative card's fields; `light: true` makes a cell a tile of the brand light (`seed` picks it).

Each picture is an image slot (`src`, `alt`, `fit`, `position`); without `src` it keeps its placeholder, which carries
`data-ds-placeholder`.

examples.name: Tiles
examples.label: Three by three with a light tile
examples.content:
import { CreativeGrid } from '@/react/components/site/CreativeGrid'
// The post's grid: nine squares 8px apart, a light tile in the middle.

const items = [
  { brand: 'Acme Skin', tone: 2 as const },
  { brand: 'Acme Studio', tone: 1 as const },
  { brand: 'Acme Drinks', tone: 3 as const },
  { brand: 'Acme Motors', tone: 1 as const },
  { light: true, seed: 0 },
  { brand: 'Acme Drinks', tone: 4 as const },
  { brand: 'Acme Fit', tone: 3 as const },
  { brand: 'Acme Studio', tone: 2 as const },
  { brand: 'Acme Skin', tone: 4 as const },
]

export default function Tiles() {
  return <CreativeGrid items={items} className="w-120 max-w-full" />
}

props.name: columns
props.description: 2, 3 or 4 columns (4 falls to 2 on phones).

props.name: gap
props.description: sm: the post's 8px. md: the ad's wider gutter.
